verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a security key, so the axis applies. The evidence shows open, standards-based protocols (passkeys/WebAuthn, OATH, PIV, OpenPGP), a device wipe command, and open firmware, but nothing documents exporting stored credentials or other data in open formats. Standards support and wiping are adjacent features, not an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
